questions.question_text:
A closed cylinder of radius $3$ cm and height $7$ cm sits on top of a prism with a square base of side $10$ cm and height $4$ cm.
Find the total surface area of the solid, correct to $2$ decimal places.

options.why: Keeps the whole prism top and adds the cylinder base too, not removing the contact circle.
Counts the cylinder's hidden base as an extra circle instead of leaving it out.
Leaves out the cylinder's curved surface $2\pi rh$ entirely.

questions.question_text:
A closed cylinder of radius $2$ cm and height $5$ cm sits on top of a prism with a square base of side $6$ cm and height $3$ cm.
Find the total surface area in exact form, in terms of $\pi$.

options.why: Added the cylinder's top circle $4\pi$ without subtracting the $4\pi$ contact hole in the prism's top face, giving $20\pi + 4\pi = 24\pi$.
Counted only one square face of the prism, using $36 + 72 = 108$ instead of $2(36) + 72 = 144$.
Made both slips at once: only one square face ($108$) and the top circle added without removing the contact hole ($24\pi$).

questions.question_text:
A cube with side length $3$ cm sits on top of a cube with side length $7$ cm. The whole bottom face of the smaller cube touches the larger cube.
Find the total surface area of the combined solid.

options.why: Adds both whole cube surface areas without subtracting the two hidden contact squares.
Subtracts only one hidden contact square of area $9\text{ cm}^{2}$.
Gives only the larger cube's surface area and leaves out the smaller cube's exposed contribution.

questions.solution_text:
The smaller cube's bottom and an equal square on the larger cube's top are hidden.
$A = 6(7)^{2} + 6(3)^{2} - 2(3)^{2}$
$= 294 + 54 - 18$
$= 330\text{ cm}^{2}$

questions.question_text:
A bolt is a cylindrical shaft of radius $1$ cm and height $5$ cm on top of a prism head with a square base of side $4$ cm and height $2$ cm.

options.why: Keeps the whole head top and adds the shaft base too, not removing the contact circle.
Leaves out the four side faces of the prism head.

questions.question_text:
A closed cylinder of radius $3.5$ cm and height $8.5$ cm sits on top of a prism with a square base of side $8$ cm and height $5$ cm.
Find the total surface area of the combined solid, correct to $1$ decimal place.

questions.question_text:
A cube with side length $2.5$ cm sits on top of a rectangular prism measuring $7$ cm by $5$ cm by $3$ cm high. The whole bottom face of the cube touches the prism.
Find the total surface area of the combined solid, correct to $1$ decimal place.

options.why: Adds the whole surface areas of both solids without subtracting the two hidden contact squares.
Subtracts only one hidden contact square of area $6.25\text{ cm}^{2}$.

questions.solution_text:
The cube's bottom and an equal square on the prism's top are hidden.
$A = 2(7)(5) + 2(7)(3) + 2(5)(3) + 6(2.5)^{2} - 2(2.5)^{2}$
$= 70 + 42 + 30 + 37.5 - 12.5$
$= 167.0\text{ cm}^{2}$
